description: Nose section only of a Canadian-built Fairchild Bolingbroke, the licence-built Blenheim; displayed to represent RAF operations from the Isle of Man.
Forward fuselage and cockpit section of a British Aerospace ATP airliner of the type that served the Isle of Man; preserved at the museum.
Commuter airliner of the type flown on Isle of Man services; preserved at the museum at Ronaldsway.
